validity.recommendation: update Status to 'operating' and StartYear1 to 2024; reconcile Capacity (EIA 829 vs sheet 1050 MMcf/d) and LengthKnown (EIA 35.8 mi = 57.60 km vs sheet 54.70 km, a ~5% gap - NOT the 35.8-vs-54.7 discrepancy first reported, which compared miles against kilometres) against FERC docket CP21-94
validity.researcher_notes: EIA has tracked this project from Announced (May 2019) through Completed (Aug 2026 release, status dated July 26, 2024). Project completed July 12, 2024 per EIA. Sheet shows 'proposed' status with LastUpdated 2023-08-15, now stale. EIA shows: length 35.8 mi (vs sheet 54.7), capacity started at 1050 MMcf/d but dropped to 829 when project transitioned to 'Part Completed' in Oct 2023. Capacity discrepancy may reflect design change or phased in-service (EIA notes Oct 23, 2023 FERC approval for interim partial service of 450 MMcf/d). Delivery points per EIA June 2020 open season: Mud Run Road PA (210 MMcf/d Phase I), Station 210 Delivery Pool NJ (640 MMcf/d Phase I), Trenton Delivery CPH NJ (190 MMcf/d Phase II) = 1040 total, close to target 1050 but actual 829 as-built suggests either capacity reduction or phasing. Length discrepancy significant: route traced in routes-repo is entirely Pennsylvania (Luzerne County 41.37°N to Monroe/Northampton 40.91°N) and measures ~35-36 mi geometric distance, supporting EIA's 35.8 mi; sheet's 54.7 mi is unexplained — may be confusion with parent system mileage or total certificated scope. EIA confirms PA→NJ crossing with new compressor station in NJ and M&R modifications in PA, NJ, and MD. Docket CP21-94 confirmed. Source: EIA Natural Gas Pipeline Projects Aug 2026 release, sheet 'Historical Projects (1996-2024)', row 1114, dated 2024-07-26. | ORCHESTRATOR 2026-09-14, two corrections to this record. (1) `contested` was keyed 'Length', which is not a backend column (it is LengthKnown), so that half of the finding tinted no cell. (2) The candidate value was EIA's 35.8 MILES aimed at a cell whose LengthKnownUnits is 'km' - pasting it would have shortened the pipe by 40%. The sheet's 54.70 km IS 34.0 mi, so the real gap against EIA's 35.8 mi is 1.8 mi (~5%), not the 35.8-vs-54.7 chasm described above. Candidate restated in the cell's own unit as 57.60 km. The recommendation to reconcile against FERC docket CP21-94 stands. [ORCHESTRATOR AUDIT 2026-09-15] Tier corrected high/independent=True -> medium/independent=False: this record's proposed_refs resolve to 1 distinct publisher(s) (eia.gov), and rule 4 counts publishers, not URLs — every EIA release is ONE origin. The FINDING is unchanged; only the confidence claim was wrong.
